start: An owner of a gym that never accepted the terms signs in (or opens the panel signed in)

user_sees: "Opening your gym…" for a moment, then the card "Before you go on"
"Please read and accept the MettleUp terms and the data agreement. They say how MettleUp keeps your gym’s records and your members’ details safe. You do this once. Your staff are not asked."
Tick box "I agree to the MettleUp terms and the data agreement.", buttons "Agree and continue" and "Sign out"
must_not: The gym's pages reachable behind the card
The box ticked by itself

user_sees: Each page opens in a new tab
must_not: The card lost or the owner signed out by opening a link

steps.action: Tick the box, tap "Agree and continue"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"; then the gym opens
must_not: The card shown again at the next open
The acceptance saved under another person's name or an older version

start: An owner who accepted an older version opens the panel after the terms were updated

user_sees: Card "Before you go on" with "We updated the MettleUp terms and the data agreement on <day>. Please read them and accept the new version. Each page has a short "What changed" line near the bottom. Your staff are not asked."
must_not: The first-time words shown to someone who accepted before
A date that is not the day the new version is dated, India time

user_sees: The gym opens; Settings shows the new version and today's day
must_not: The old acceptance record lost

start: An owner who ticked the terms at "Create my gym"

steps.action: Open the panel, then Settings → Your data
user_sees: No terms card; the line "You accepted the terms on <day> (version <version>)."
must_not: The card asked a second time for the same version

user_sees: "Tick the box first. Then tap “Agree and continue”."
must_not: The gym opened without the tick
A save sent

steps.action: Tick and tap with no internet
user_sees: "Can’t reach the internet. Check the connection and try again."; the button is live again
must_not: The gym opened as if accepted
The card stuck on "Saving…"

steps.action: A front desk person of the same gym opens the panel
user_sees: The gym opens with no card
must_not: Staff asked to accept, or able to accept for the owner

start: Terms card showing for an owner

user_sees: The welcome page with "You are signed out of this device."
must_not: The terms saved as accepted by signing out
The gym opened without the card

steps.action: Accept, close the panel, open it again; then open it with no internet
user_sees: The gym opens with no card both times (with no internet after a short "Opening your gym…")
must_not: An owner locked out of the desk while offline
The card asked again after acceptance

steps.action: On slow internet, start typing in the gym before the answer comes; the answer says the terms are still needed
user_sees: The card, and after accepting, the gym as it was
must_not: Typed work thrown away without a word when the card takes over the page

start: Settings → Your data, as the owner

user_sees: "You accepted the terms on <day> (version <version>)." with the day in India time
must_not: The line shown with another gym's day
No record of who agreed, when, which version and how
A day shifted by the device's own time zone
